Later same-element issue FHIR-9987 added the logical-model clarification that now appears in the same comment, and a 2025 Zulip discussion confirms abstract profiles are intent rather than mandatory validator rejection semantics.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active source already implements the seed issue and no semantic source correction is needed.
